title: P2 audit.verify: request
description: Check the audit hash chain of a tenant or farm and compare it with the signed head at the witness (AUD-6, spec/hashing.md).

heads.description: Heads of the chain that the witness kept in the history of the monitoring system, oldest first; verify checks the signature of each, seq growing within an epoch and each head of the current epoch against its record (MON-3).
